home.heroTitle: SafarisCon: fata umwanya kuri serivisi mu Rwanda
home.heroLead: Shakisha amahoteli yizewe, kafe, gukodesha imodoka, ahantu, urugendo, n'izindi serivisi z'inzira uva ku batanga serivisi bemejwe. Reba ku mugaragaro, hanyuma ukore konti iyo witeguye gufata umwanya no gucunga serivisi yawe.
home.onePlaceTitle: Ahantu hamwe hateganyijwe ku serivisi z'urugendo mu Rwanda
home.onePlaceLead: SafarisCon ihuza abashyitsi n'abatanga serivisi bakeneye uburyo bwumwuga bwo gutangaza ibyabo, kwakira ibyasabwe, no gufasha abakiriya. Urubuga rwubatswe ku mahoteli, kafe, gukodesha imodoka, amatsinda y'urugendo, ahantu, serivisi z'ibiribwa, n'abatanga serivisi z'urugendo.
home.hotelsAndStaysDesc: Ibyumba, amazu yo kuruhukira, amazu y'abashyitsi, n'aho kuruhuka byemejwe.
home.cafesAndFoodDesc: Fata umwanya kuri kafe, resitora, boulangerie, n'ibiribwa byo mu gace.
home.carRentalsDesc: Shakisha ubwikorezi, gutwara abagenzi, gukodesha imodoka, n'iyo kugenda.
home.toursAndExperiencesDesc: Menya gusura umuco, ibirori, abayobozi, n'ibikorwa.
home.servicesLead: Reba serivisi zemewe hepfo, cyangwa shakisha ahantu n'amatariki mu ifishi hejuru.
home.bookOnlineTitle: Fata umwanya kuri serivisi kuri murandasi na SafarisCon
home.trustLead: SafarisCon ni isoko ryo gufata umwanya. Wishyura muri porogaramu. Dutunga amafaranga, turinda amakuru y'utanga serivisi kugeza wishyuye, hanyuma ni bwo ubona ibikenewe mu rugendo.
home.trustLine: Ntitwandika ijambo ry'ibanga ryawe. Ntitwereka hoteli numero y'ikarita yawe. Ntitwohereza hoteli amafaranga yose y'icyasabwe ako kanya wishyuye.
home.cancelNote: Buri serivisi yerekana igihe cyo guhagarika n'igiciro cyayo. Ibisanzwe ni amasaha 6 na 20%.
home.faqTitle: Ibibazo ku gufata umwanya na SafarisCon
home.faq1q: Abashyitsi bashobora kureba serivisi batagira konti?
home.faq1a: Yego. Abashyitsi ku mugaragaro bashobora gushakisha no kureba abatanga serivisi bahari mbere yo gufata icyemezo cyo kwinjira cyangwa kwiyandikisha.
home.faq2a: Ukeneye konti iyo ushaka gufata umwanya, kwishyura, gucunga ibyasabwe, cyangwa gufungura amakuru y'utanga serivisi.
home.faq3a: Amahoteli, kafe, resitora, amatsinda yo gukodesha imodoka, abakora urugendo, ahantu, n'abandi batanga serivisi zihuye n'urugendo bashobora kwiyandikisha.
home.faq4a: Inzira yo gufata umwanya igumana amakuru y'utanga serivisi ateganyijwe, yandika intambwe zo kwishyura, kandi iha abakiriya inyandiko z'icyemezo kuri serivisi yabo.

howSteps.1body: Serivisi ku mugaragaro zihisha izina nyaryo ry'utanga serivisi, telefoni, n'aderesi nyayo. Ubona icyiciro, agace, amafoto, n'igiciro.
howSteps.2body: Imeri n'ijambo ry'ibanga, hanyuma twemeza imeri yawe hakoreshejwe kode imwe. Kwinjira ni ijambo ry'ibanga hamwe na kode twohereza kuri imeri.
howSteps.3body: Zimwe serivisi zemeza ubwazo; izindi zitegereza utanga serivisi. Mu buryo bwose, wishyura igiciro cyose muri porogaramu — si 30% y'ingwate, kandi si amafaranga ku kigo.
howSteps.4title: Ishyura na Mobile Money cyangwa ikarita
howSteps.4body: Kwishyura bigana muri porogaramu ya SafarisCon, si ku hoteli ako kanya. Iyo kwishyura byagenze neza, amakuru y'utanga serivisi n'ikode y'icyasabwe birakinguka.
howSteps.5body: Ibisanzwe: kugeza amasaha 6 mbere ya serivisi, ushobora guhagarika ukabona 80%; 20% ni igiciro cyo guhagarika. Serivisi ishobora gushyiraho amasaha n'ijanisha bitandukanye. Nyuma y'igihe ntarengwa, Hagarika bihishwa kandi icyasabwe kigumana agaciro.
howSteps.6body: Utanga serivisi arayisuzuma. Nta kwishyura kabiri ugeze aho.

heroTitle: Uburyo bworoshye bwo kubona serivisi z'urugendo, gufata umwanya ako kanya hose mu Rwanda, no kwishyura mu gihe nyacyo

fastBooking: Gufata umwanya vuba mu gihe nyacyo
fastBookingDesc: Kuva ku kibazo kugeza ku cyasabwe cyemejwe mu gihe nyacyo. Urubuga rwacu rworohereza itumanaho ryihuse n'icyemezo cya serivisi ako kanya ku byo ukeneye mu rugendo.
planTrip: Tegura urugendo rwawe na SafarisCon uhuzwe n'abatanga serivisi bizewe ku mahoteli, ubwikorezi, urugendo, n'izindi serivisi z'abashyitsi ku rubuga rumwe.
everythingTravel: Ibyo ukeneye byose mu rugendo, ahantu hamwe, amahoteli, ubwikorezi, ibyo gukora, n'izindi serivisi z'abashyitsi bihujwe hamwe.

legal.provider5: Niba umushyitsi ahagaritse mu gihe, wakira umugabane wawe w'amafaranga yo kuhagarika, si icyasabwe cyose.
legal.provider6: Niba atahagaritse, wakira umugabane wawe w'icyasabwe cyose nyuma y'igihe, iyo SafarisCon yemeje kwishyurwa.
legal.provider7: Kurarangiza icyasabwe bisobanura kwemeza kode gusa — ntukusanye amafaranga ya kabiri mu ntoki.
legal.provider8: Ntushyire nimero za konti yo kwishyurwa ku ifishi rusange ya serivisi.
legal.platform1: Dushobora kwanga cyangwa guhagarika konti zikoresha nabi OTP, kwishyura, cyangwa serivisi.
legal.platform2: Uburyo bwo kwishyura buva ku rutonde rw'ubu. Ntukekereze sosiyete imwe ya telefoni.
legal.platform3: Komisiyo, igihe gisanzwe cyo kuhagarika, n'igihano gisanzwe bishobora gutandukana ku serivisi / ubucuruzi.
legal.collect1why: Konti, aho uhura ku cyasabwe, inyemezabuguzi, kwinjira hakoreshejwe OTP
legal.collect3data: Amatariki y'icyasabwe, amasaha, umubare w'abashyitsi, aho ujya
legal.collect4why: Birakenewe ku byasabwe kugira ngo utanga serivisi ateganye serivisi
legal.collect5data: Izina, imeri, n'numero ya MoMo yo kwishyura (cyangwa kwishyura n'ikarita)
legal.collect6data: Amakuru ya MoMo / banki yo kwishyurwa k'utanga serivisi
legal.collect6why: Kwishyura utanga serivisi nyuma y'igihe cyo kuhagarika — ntiberekanwa abashyitsi
legal.collect8why: Reba za rupapuro n'ibikorwa by'icyasabwe. Dutunga IP yahinduwe, ubwoko bw'igikoresho, na mushakisha — si IP nyayo mu nyandiko y'igikorwa
legal.not2: Ntidushyira abandi bakiriya imeri, telefoni, cyangwa icyasabwe cyawe.
legal.not3: Ntidushyira telefoni y'utanga serivisi, aderesi nyayo, cyangwa ikimenyetso cy'ikarita ku rupapuro rusange rwa mbere.
legal.not4: Ntidutunga PIN y'ikarita yawe cyangwa PIN ya MoMo. Kwishyura n'ikarita biba ku rupapuro rw'umutanga kwishyura. Kwemera MoMo biba kuri telefoni yawe.
legal.hiddenBody: Mbere yo kwishyura, serivisi zikoresha izina ridahishurwa. Ushobora kubona akarere / agace n'amafoto. Telefoni, aderesi nyayo, n'inzira biguma bifunze. Nyuma yo kwishyura byose, icyo cyasabwe gikungurira umwirondoro, aho uhura, n'aho biherereye. Abandi bakoresha bagikomeza kubona serivisi idahishurwa.
legal.processor1: XentriPay — ikusanya kwishyura kwa MoMo/ikarita muri porofolio y'umucuruzi ya SafarisCon hanyuma yishyura abatanga serivisi / isubiza abashyitsi.
legal.processor3: Kubika amafoto — amadosiye ya serivisi n'inyemezabuguzi.
legal.controlsBody: Hindura izina / telefoni aho urupapuro rwa konti rumaze kubyemera. Sohoka kugira ngo urangize igihe cyibutse. Abatanga serivisi bahindura amakuru yo kwishyurwa ku rupapuro rw'amakuru yo kwishyurwa. Ku gusiba konti cyangwa kohereza amakuru, andikira {email}.
legal.securityBody: HTTPS, amagambo y'ibanga yahinduwe, OTP zahinduwe, inyemezabumenyi za Bearer, isuzuma ry'inshingano, CORS, n'imitwe y'umutekano. Inzira z'ibanga z'icyasabwe n'izo kwishyura zisaba ukoresha winjiye. Ushobora kwishyura cyangwa kuhagarika ibyasabwe byawe gusa.
legal.paymentsPageLead: Wishyura igiciro cyose cyerekanwe muri porogaramu. Amafaranga atungwa muri porofolio ya SafarisCon kugeza igihe cyo kuhagarika kirangiye.
legal.pay1: Ifaranga ni RWF. Uburyo: Mobile Money cyangwa ikarita.
legal.pay2: Wishyura igiciro cyose cyerekanwe. Nta 30% yo gutanga mbere kandi nta 70% asigaye ku kigo.
legal.pay3: Amafaranga akusanyirizwa muri porofolio ya SafarisCon. Hoteli ntiyishyurwa muri icyo gihe.
legal.pay4: Serivisi ntishobora kwishyurwa kugeza utanga serivisi abitse amakuru nyayo ya MoMo cyangwa banki yo kwishyurwa.
legal.afterPayBody: Icyasabwe cyishyuwe byose. Amakuru y'utanga serivisi n'kode y'icyasabwe / QR / inyemezabuguzi bikingurwa. Ushobora kuhagarika gusa kugeza igihe ntarengwa cyo kuhagarika icyasabwe.
legal.afterPayQuote: Cyishyuwe byose. Erekana kode y'icyasabwe ku kigo. Ushobora kuhagarika kugeza igihe ntarengwa cyerekanwe. Niba uhagaritse mbere yacyo, usubizwa amasubiranyo ukuyemo amafaranga yo kuhagarika ya serivisi.
legal.cancellationBody: Ibyasabwe byishyuwe gusa ni byo bishobora kuhagarikwa kugira ngo hasubizwe amafaranga. Serivisi ishyiraho amasaha mbere ya serivisi aho kuhagarika bifungwa (bisanzwe 6) n'ijanisha ry'icyo wishyuye utakaza (bisanzwe 20). Buri gihe koresha imibare iri ku cyasabwe cyawe. Amasubiranyo akunze kugera nyuma y'igihe gito cyo gukorwa.
legal.money1: Yishyuwe, nta kuhagarika: nyuma y'igihe ntarengwa cyo kuhagarika, SafarisCon yishyura utanga serivisi umugabane we. Ujya ku kigo ufite kode y'icyasabwe.
legal.money2: Hagarika mu gihe: amasubiranyo = yishyuwe − amafaranga yo kuhagarika. Amasubiranyo asubira binyuze ku mufatanyabikorwa wo kwishyura.
legal.money3: Hagarika nyuma y'igihe: nta masubiranyo. Icyasabwe gikomeza gukoreshwa ku kigo.
legal.atVenueBody: Utanga serivisi yemeza kode y'icyasabwe. Kurangiza icyasabwe ntibishyura ikindi.
legal.guestRegister: Abashyitsi bakora konti yabo n'izina, imeri, n'ijambo ry'ibanga.
legal.providerRegister: Amahoteli n'abandi batanga serivisi ntibiyandikisha ubwabo. SafarisCon irabatumira; barangiza kwiyandikisha, bashyiraho ijambo ry'ibanga, kandi bongereho amakuru yo kwishyurwa mbere yo gukusanya kwishyura.
legal.emailLoginBody: Nyuma yo kwiyandikisha twohereza kode y'imibare 6 kuri imeri (hafi iminota 10). Kwinjira ni imeri + ijambo ry'ibanga, hanyuma kode yo kwinjira y'inshuro imwe. Turinda konti hakoreshejwe kwemeza imeri n'kode yo kwinjira, si ijambo ry'ibanga gusa. Amagambo y'ibanga abikwa yahinduwe. Nyibuke itanga inyemezabumenyi yo kuvugurura hafi umunsi umwe. Gusohoka kurangiza icyo gihe.

guestTerms1: Ugomba kwandika imeri nyayo urangize kwemeza hakoreshejwe kode.
guestTerms2: Uri n'inshingano zo kuba amatariki, amasaha, umubare w'abashyitsi, n'aho uherereye wanditse ari ukuri.
guestTerms3: Gufata umwanya ni amasezerano yo kwishyura igiciro cyose cyerekanwe. Icyamamare gikora gusa niba serivisi icyari ifite igihe ufata umwanya.
guestTerms4: Umwirondoro w'utanga serivisi uhishwa kugeza wishyuye. Gukoresha porogaramu gukusanya imibonano mbere yo kwishyura ntibyemewe.
guestTerms5: Nyuma yo kwishyura ubona kode y'icyasabwe. Yizane (cyangwa QR / inyemezabuguzi) ku kigo.
guestTerms6: Guhagarika bikorwa gusa mu gihe kiri ku cyasabwe. Nyuma yacyo, nta masubiranyo kuri iyi buto yo kuhagarika.
guestTerms7: SafarisCon ni isoko n'uwatunga amafaranga. Gutura / igikorwa bikozwe n'utanga serivisi wanditswe.
